name: 01463 · Pepperell, MA
findings: ZIP 01463 (Pepperell) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01463 (Pepperell) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01463 (Pepperell) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 27% of the typical level).
